name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-artifact (reports, plans, architecture explanations, and interactive product targets), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), get-pr-comments (triages a PR's feedback into a prioritized action list, read-only), adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, rules, and Claude output styles onto a machine, additively), me-human (dogfood a system from a human user's perspective), test-audit (gates new tests and audits or prunes low-value ones), trim-comments (removes comment slop from the branch diff before review; offers encodings for constraint comments), grill-me (a relentless interview that sharpens a plan, run by grilling), and improve-codebase-architecture (finds deepening refactors, with codebase-design and domain-modeling). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.

interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Workshop toolkit plugin. Codex exposes the html-artifact, ui-demo-video, get-pr-comments, adopt-global-rules, me-human, test-audit, trim-comments, grill-me, grilling, improve-codebase-architecture, codebase-design, and domain-modeling skills from this package: the optional layer next to the workbench plugin.
defaultPrompt: Turn a markdown report into a standalone HTML page.
Draw an architecture map of a subsystem or refactor as a standalone page.
Record a UI demo video of a change in the running app.
Author or edit a skill with baseline testing.
Install the workshop's global CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and rules onto this machine.
Use this system the way a real human user would, and report what got in the way.
